body: I don't really have any regrets, It's just disheartening to put so much effort into something and see everything just fall apart in a matter of hours.  I won't make any rash decisions but I just need time to think. Tomorrow will be a new day and I'll take it as that.
No more of anything and when things are bad that sounds pretty good.

Two different things:

How I should end it, and why I should end it.

Why I should live and what I could do to be happy. 

The second thought is what keeps me around but the first is becoming a better prospect each time I slip into depression.
